# Stage 8 skill evaluation fixture

The public corpus is intentionally organized as reusable skills rather than named agents or a mandatory workflow pipeline. The recovered historical corpus at commit `40114acc` contained 19 public skills; the current corpus retains those and adds `artifact-to-project`, `canonical-to-artifact`, and `project-initialization` for the canonical-state loop.

The checks verify front matter, progressive-disclosure descriptions, absence of retired integration/controller/provider language, and distinct empirical and theoretical guidance. Private user style material remains outside this package under the private Pi overlay.
